name: Minor Supplier Delay with High Inventory Buffer
description: Minor delay of 2 days reported for SKU-1001 at Bengaluru Plant SITE-BLR-02 where stock cover is 15 days. Expediting or reordering costs outweigh any benefit.
report_text: LOGISTICS NOTICE: Supplier Apex Micro Systems (SUP-001) notified a 2-day minor logistics dispatch delay for SKU-1001 to Bengaluru Systems Assembly Plant (SITE-BLR-02). Severity: 2.
test_purpose: Doing nothing (HOLD) is rational and cost-optimal when existing stock safely absorbs the variance.
